recess_diameter = 40.0

mount_hole_count = 4
boss_diameter = 30.0
boss_height = 4.0

solid_body = solid_body - recess

central_hole = Cylinder(central_hole_diameter / 2, height)
solid_body = solid_body - central_hole

boss = Pos(0, 0, -height / 2 + boss_height / 2) * Cylinder(boss_diameter / 2, boss_height)
solid_body = solid_body + boss

part = solid_body
